findings.issue: With Threaded mode on, /status sent in All creates an empty '/status' topic and the card lands in All (PV1-A3 / CR3-V-4 missing); documented and deferred by the owner.
findings.fix: Inspect message_thread_id/is_topic_message of the All update, route the reply accordingly (or to Control), add a case to tests/telegram/test_status_is_dashboard.py, then the owner re-checks O1.

findings.issue: The verbatim Apache-2.0 text is followed by a 3-line pointer to NOTICE; GitHub's license detection (about 98% similarity) may not recognise the file as Apache-2.0.
findings.fix: Move the pointer into README/NOTICE so LICENSE equals the apache.org file, or confirm the repo sidebar shows Apache-2.0 after publishing.

findings.issue: Carried from review-a: a channel that dies immediately is restarted every 1-2 s without back-off.
findings.fix: No restart sooner than 60 s after a channel that lived under 10 s; log the repeat once.

findings.issue: Carried from review-oss: bare-domain confidentiality_floor entries are not in the strict tier.
findings.fix: Treat domain-shaped floor entries without '@' as strict too.
